name: cc
description:
Delegate code review and implementation work to Claude Code from inside Codex.

Use cc when you want an independent second opinion on a diff, an adversarial pass over a risky change before merge, or to hand a substantial task to another agent. Reviews run read-only against the real repository.

interface.shortDescription: A second engineering voice, on demand
interface.longDescription: cc delegates reviews and implementation work to Claude Code. Reviews run read-only with access to the whole repository, so findings are verified against real call sites rather than guessed from a diff.
